summary: Phase 53 (fee structure delete/archive/unarchive + branded /login/<code> + Login Page settings + preset cards moved to wizard + academic_year_id in structures) end-to-end tested on Sunrise and p50demo. Backend pytest tests/test_phase53.py: 6/6 PASS. This can't be undone.' → confirmed → toast 'Fee structure deleted' → gone. Created 'QA temp archive flow' → Archive dialog 'Archive QA temp archive flow? It won't be offered for new students or new invoices…' confirmed → disappeared from list, 'Show archived (1)' counter updated. Toggled Show archived → row visible with ARCHIVED badge, Apply/Generate buttons removed (edit/clone remain). Unarchive confirm dialog → row returned to active list with Apply/Generate restored. Deleted → gone. Settings → Login page card shows live preview with Sunrise photo, logo, tagline; tagline save flow verified by changing to 'Learning that lights the way — QA ping', confirming via public /api/public/institutions/sunrise/branding, then restoring original tagline. Academic Units page on Sunrise has NO preset buttons (only 'New Academic Unit' + existing HS/Primary rows). Setup wizard throwaway school admin@sunrise-setup.in → /app/setup → Academic Configuration step still shows 'Start from a preset' cards (LP / UP / HS / HSS Kerala + K-12 single unit) with Apply preset buttons — presets correctly only in wizard. Sunrise admin apply-preset returns 409 (setup complete). Principal thomas@sunrise-demo.in correctly 403 on DELETE and POST /archive. Public branding 404 for unknown slug. LPGS branding read-only check: tagline '', background custom (unchanged). No existing Sunrise/p50demo structures were archived or deleted; only QA temp throwaways created and cleaned up.

minor.issue: Cache-Control header on preview is 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' (likely proxy/middleware override) — spec/pytest expect 'public, max-age=…'. Branded /api/public/institutions/<code>/login-background correctly carries public cache-control. Low priority.

The default login background endpoint on preview returns no-store cache-control (minor deviation from spec; branded bg is fine).
rca of the issue: Minor cache-control deviation on /api/public/login-default.jpg likely caused by a global response middleware (session/no-cache) applied to '/api/*' paths that overrides the explicit Cache-Control set by the handler, OR by Kubernetes ingress inserting no-store. The branded /api/public/institutions/<code>/login-background path still keeps 'public,max-age=…' which suggests only the default-file route is affected. Mitigation: either serve the default via same path pattern or explicitly re-apply Cache-Control after middleware. Not customer-impacting (browser will refetch the default each visit; file is ~tens of KB).
